method: Independently map every distinct owned semantic proposition to manually specified atoms; apply to every packet; cross-check allowed frozen pure functions. Structural segmentation and final policy comparison share author policy, so this is not fully independent ontology validation.

summary.empty_vs_refused_conclusion: Structural-only examined records are empty. Twenty missing quantitative-value propositions are meaningful but unrepresentable by the frozen ontology and require whole-packet refusal; supported temporal clauses in those records must not make partial extraction count as complete.
summary.ownership_conclusion: Atoms, claims and refs assigned only to each owned source span. Context-only CLM-NEIGHBOR and REF-9999 excluded throughout.
summary.source_conflict_conclusion: Preserve all explicit CLM identifiers, including numeric disagreement. Retain simultaneous nonoccurrence/uncertainty as separate source-supported statements; flag source tension without fabricating a resolution.

diversity_assessment: All 260 substantive rows have distinct gap/uncertainty atom sets even after removing domains, prose, refs, span ownership and claim counts. This is valid combinatorial semantic expansion, not merely surface duplication. It is not 260 independent linguistic constructions: the small repeated clause inventory, fixed 11/14/17/29 quantities and synthetic domain substitutions materially limit natural-language and domain-generalization claims.
limits: No protected labels, author code, dataset, targets, other benchmark data, model generation, training, network or git accessed.
Machine review only; no human adjudication or model generalization measurement.
Common frozen ontology and structural parser dependence; agreement is internal consistency evidence.
Source conflicts retained as distinct explicit claims; no assumption that a contradictory record should be refused.
Out-of-ontology refusal is a finite-policy completeness decision; a general free-text extractor could express the missing quantity.
